optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware

professionalSummary.text: Released firmware to the installed station fleet over the air and watched charging session success rates after each release.
professionalSummary.witness: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Takes the field on-call for faults the operations centre raises against stations and has handled fleet-wide incidents.
experienceHighlights.witness: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet-wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on-call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Coordinates each release's station rollout waves with the operations centre and records own responsibility boundaries.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign-off.

skills.text: Tests each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release with a documented test record.
skills.witness: Tested each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's firmware release, on-call handling, rollout coordination, hardware testing, and release notes. They do not establish the candidate's ownership of these tasks or the exact number of firmware versions released.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide sufficient evidence to support the candidate's qualifications for the role, but further human review is required to make a final decision.
